title: 两个独立的群并行运算
Independent operations in parallel
text: 直积 G×H 的元素是有序对，运算逐坐标进行。单位元是 (e,e)，逆元是 (g⁻¹,h⁻¹)。
The direct product has ordered pairs as elements and coordinatewise multiplication. Its identity is (e,e) and its inverses are coordinatewise.
example: ℤ₄×ℤ₆ 的元素 ([a],[b]) 每一步分别在两个圆周上前进。两边同时回到原点才完成一个周期。
In ℤ₄×ℤ₆, each coordinate moves around its own cycle. Both must return simultaneously.

title: 直积中元素的阶
Orders in a direct product
text: 若 g、h 都为有限阶，则有此公式；任意一个坐标无穷阶时，(g,h) 也无穷阶。
For finite-order coordinates, the pair has order equal to their least common multiple. If either coordinate has infinite order, so does the pair.
proof: (g,h)ᵏ=(gᵏ,hᵏ)，所以它等于单位元当且仅当两个坐标都回到单位元。
(g,h)ᵏ=(gᵏ,hᵏ), so both coordinates must be identities.
有限阶时，条件是 |g|∣k 且 |h|∣k，最小正解为最小公倍数；无穷阶坐标则不存在这样的 k。
For finite orders, k must be a multiple of both orders. Infinite-order coordinates never return for positive k.

title: 两个循环群的直积何时循环
When a product of cyclic groups is cyclic
text: 对正整数 m,n，直积为循环群当且仅当两个阶互素。关键比较是元素可能达到的最大阶与群的总阶。
For positive m,n, the product is cyclic exactly when the orders are coprime. Compare the largest possible element order with mn.
proof: 若 gcd(m,n)=1，两个生成元组成的元素阶为 lcm(m,n)=mn，因此生成全群。
If m and n are coprime, a pair of generators has order mn and generates the whole product.
若 gcd(m,n)>1，任意元素的阶都整除 lcm(m,n)<mn，所以没有生成元。
If they are not coprime, every element order divides lcm(m,n)<mn, so no element generates the product.

title: 内部直积分解
Internal direct products
entries.tex: G=HK,\ H,K\trianglelefteq G,\ H\cap K=\{e\}\quad\Longrightarrow\quad G\cong H\times K
text: 若两个正规子群交平凡且乘积覆盖 G，则每个元素都能唯一写成 hk，且两个因子互相交换。
If two normal subgroups intersect trivially and their product covers G, every element has a unique expression hk and the factors commute.
proof: 对 h∈H,k∈K，交换子 hkh⁻¹k⁻¹ 因 H、K 都正规而同时属于 H、K，故等于 e。
The commutator hkh⁻¹k⁻¹ belongs to both H and K by normality; trivial intersection forces it to be e.
定义 H×K→G，(h,k)↦hk。因两个因子交换，映射保乘法；G=HK 保证满射。
The map (h,k)↦hk preserves multiplication because the factors commute, and is onto by G=HK.
若 hk=e，则 h=k⁻¹∈H∩K，所以 h=k=e，核平凡，映射是同构。
If hk=e, h=k⁻¹ belongs to the intersection. Thus both are identities and the map is injective.
warning: 仅有 H∩K={e} 且 G=HK 不够：D₃=⟨r⟩⟨s⟩，但 D₃ 不是 C₃×C₂。
Trivial intersection and G=HK alone do not suffice: D₃=⟨r⟩⟨s⟩ is not C₃×C₂.

title: 从群论看中国剩余定理
The Chinese remainder map
entries.tex: \mathbb Z/mn\mathbb Z\longrightarrow\mathbb Z/m\mathbb Z\times\mathbb Z/n\mathbb Z,\quad[x]\mapsto([x],[x])
text: 当 m,n 互素时，这个自然映射是加法群同构。一个整数的模 mn 信息，可以由模 m 与模 n 的两份信息共同确定。
For coprime m,n, the natural residue map is an isomorphism of additive groups. The two residues together determine the residue modulo mn.
proof: 模 mn 相等蕴含模 m、模 n 分别相等，所以映射良定义且保加法。
Congruence modulo mn implies congruence modulo m and n; the map is well-defined and additive.
若 x 同时被 m,n 整除，由互素性得 mn∣x，因此核平凡。
If both m and n divide x, coprimality implies mn∣x, so the kernel is trivial.
源、目标都有 mn 个元素，有限集合上的单射于是为双射。
Both sets have mn elements, so this injection is a bijection.
example: 求 x≡2 mod 3，x≡3 mod 5：在模 15 下唯一解为 [8]。
The congruences x≡2 mod 3 and x≡3 mod 5 have the unique solution [8] modulo 15.

question: ℤ₄×ℤ₆ 中 ([1],[1]) 的阶是多少？
What is the order of ([1],[1]) in ℤ₄×ℤ₆?
reason: It is lcm(4,6)=12, not the product.

question: 哪个群同构于 C₁₂？
Which group is isomorphic to C₁₂?
reason: 3 与 4 互素，C₃×C₄ 是 12 阶循环群。
The coprime orders 3 and 4 give a cyclic product of order 12.

question: 内部直积分解中，哪组条件充分？
Which conditions suffice for an internal direct product?
options: H,K 正规、交平凡且 G=HK
reason: 两个正规子群的交换子落在交集中，故因子交换；其余条件给出双射。
Normality puts mixed commutators in the intersection; the remaining conditions give a bijection.

question: x≡1 mod 3，x≡2 mod 4 的模 12 解是？
Solve x≡1 mod 3, x≡2 mod 4 modulo 12.
reason: 10≡1 mod 3 且 10≡2 mod 4；互素性保证模 12 唯一。
10 satisfies both; coprimality ensures uniqueness modulo 12.

question: 证明：若 G×H 循环，则 G、H 都循环。
Prove that if G×H is cyclic, then both factors are cyclic.
reason: 设 G×H=⟨(g,h)⟩。投影到第一坐标得到 G=⟨g⟩，投影到第二坐标得到 H=⟨h⟩。逆命题还需要额外条件。
Project a generator (g,h) to each coordinate: every element of G is a power of g, and likewise for H. The converse needs additional hypotheses.

label: 补充应用
Supplementary application
crt.note: 中国剩余定理的群论表述，作为互素阶循环群直积的应用。
